notes.title: Full Controller Support Added
notes.content:
Version 1.2 is here with the highly requested controller support. The game should now support most controllers with 2 analogue sticks.

Patch Notes:

Added full controller support in game and in menus. Can be accessed in the top right of the Settings menu.
Changed the way materials are loaded. Should reduce stutter when first picking up and firing a weapon.
Changed the loading system. Returning to the Main Menu from a level should now be significantly faster.

notes.title: Free-Play Mode Is Here
notes.content:
Free Play mode is now available on any regular level with a gold time. Free Play allows any weapon to be used, however times will not be applied to the save's progression.


General Fixes:

 Removed extraneous target counters that were left over on some levels.
 Fixed a bug that caused multiple demo silhouettes of targets to be visible through scopes on some stages.
 Various animation fixes.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Fixed a few animation bugs
Displayed tracked stats on the shooting range menus
